dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Fighting monsters is nothing new to me.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: If anything... It is these brief periods of leisure between battles that I'm not accustomed to.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: No matter. If you need to rest, I will stay here with you until you are ready.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: The air grows thick with the stench of evil...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I could handle the upcoming battles on my own, but I know you wouldn't agree to it.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: So promise me at least that you will not let your guard down.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: The legacy of the yakshas lives on in the historical records that tell our tales... Still, that brings no solace to me or my late comrades.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: But watching the Xiao Lanterns rise into the sky during the Lantern Rite... that is what brings me peace.
